tools.name: debug_pause
tools.title: Pause Emulator
tools.description: Pause execution at current instruction; enter debugger.

tools.name: debug_continue
tools.title: Continue Execution
tools.description: Resume emulator execution from pause or breakpoint.

tools.name: debug_step_into
tools.title: Step Into
tools.description: Step next 6502 CPU instruction; enter subroutines.

tools.name: debug_step_over
tools.title: Step Over
tools.description: Step next 6502 CPU instruction; skip JSR subroutines.

tools.name: debug_step_out
tools.title: Step Out
tools.description: Run until RTS/RTI returns from current subroutine/interrupt.

tools.name: debug_step_frame
tools.title: Step Frame
tools.description: Run one or more Atari Lynx video frames to VBlank. Default mode is async; use mode sync to wait until all requested frames complete.

tools.name: debug_reset
tools.title: Reset System
tools.description: Reset the emulated Atari Lynx system.

tools.name: debug_get_status
tools.title: Get Debug Status
tools.description: Read debugger state: paused, breakpoint hit, current PC, total emulated cycles.

tools.name: set_breakpoint
tools.title: Set Breakpoint
tools.description: Add execute/read/write breakpoint in Atari Lynx 64K CPU address space.

tools.name: set_breakpoint_range
tools.title: Set Range Breakpoint
tools.description: Add execute/read/write breakpoint over Atari Lynx 64K CPU address range.

tools.name: remove_breakpoint
tools.title: Remove Breakpoint
tools.description: Remove matching single/range CPU breakpoint by address and optional end_address.

tools.name: list_breakpoints
tools.title: List Breakpoints
tools.description: List all CPU execution/read/write breakpoints.

tools.name: set_breakpoint_on_irq
tools.title: Set IRQ Breakpoint
tools.description: Add IRQ breakpoint for Mikey timer interrupt 0-7.

tools.name: clear_breakpoint_on_irq
tools.title: Clear IRQ Breakpoint
tools.description: Remove IRQ breakpoint for Mikey timer interrupt 0-7.

tools.name: list_breakpoints_on_irq
tools.title: List IRQ Breakpoints
tools.description: List active IRQ breakpoints; returns timer IRQ numbers 0-7.

tools.name: list_memory_areas
tools.title: List Memory Areas
tools.description: List memory areas/tabs and CPU ranges: RAM, STACK, BIOS; use returned CPU addresses for read/write.

tools.name: read_memory
tools.title: Read Memory
tools.description: Read bytes from memory area by CPU address within listed range.

tools.name: write_memory
tools.title: Write Memory
tools.description: Write hex bytes to memory area by CPU address within listed range.

tools.name: write_6502_register
tools.title: Write CPU Register
tools.description: Write 6502 CPU register PC, A, X, Y, S, or P.

tools.name: get_disassembly
tools.title: Get Disassembly
tools.description: Read recorded 6502 disassembly for CPU address range: segment, mnemonic, bytes. Records exist after execution; max practical range 0x2000.

tools.name: get_media_info
tools.title: Get ROM Info
tools.description: Read loaded Atari Lynx ROM info: path, type, size, mapper, BIOS paths.

tools.name: list_recent_media
tools.title: List Recent Media
tools.description: List recent ROMs with file_path values for load_media.

tools.name: get_6502_status
tools.title: Get CPU Status
tools.description: Read 6502 CPU state: registers, flags, interrupts, MAPCTL memory-map visibility.

tools.name: get_mikey_registers
tools.title: Get Mikey Registers
tools.description: Read Mikey registers $FD00-$FDFF; optional single address filter.

tools.name: write_mikey_register
tools.title: Write Mikey Register
tools.description: Write Mikey register $FD00-$FDFF.

tools.name: get_mikey_timers
tools.title: Get Mikey Timers
tools.description: Read Mikey timer state for timers 0-7; optional single timer filter.

tools.name: get_mikey_audio
tools.title: Get Mikey Audio
tools.description: Read Mikey audio state for channels 0-3; optional single channel filter.

tools.name: get_suzy_registers
tools.title: Get Suzy Registers
tools.description: Read Suzy registers $FC00-$FCFF; optional single address filter.

tools.name: write_suzy_register
tools.title: Write Suzy Register
tools.description: Write Suzy register $FC00-$FCFF.

tools.name: get_uart_status
tools.title: Get UART Status
tools.description: Read UART/ComLynx serial status.

tools.name: reset_comlynx_metrics
tools.title: Reset ComLynx Metrics
tools.description: Reset ComLynx transport and stall diagnostics.

tools.name: get_cart_status
tools.title: Get Cartridge Status
tools.description: Read cartridge status: address generation, banks, AUDIN.

tools.name: get_eeprom_status
tools.title: Get EEPROM Status
tools.description: Read EEPROM status: type, size, mode, state, I/O pins.

tools.name: get_lcd_status
tools.title: Get LCD Status
tools.description: Read LCD status: line, visible/VBlank type, cycle, pixel/DMA info on visible lines.

tools.name: get_screenshot
tools.title: Capture Screenshot
tools.description: Capture current screen/frame/video output as PNG screenshot image.

tools.name: get_frame_buffer
tools.title: Get Frame Buffer
tools.description: Capture debug frame buffer PNG: vidbas Suzy video buffer or dispadr Mikey display address.

tools.name: get_sprite
tools.title: Get Sprite
tools.description: Read/render SCB sprite: PNG image or metadata (SCB address, position, size, BPP, type, flip flags).

tools.name: load_media
tools.title: Load ROM
tools.description: Load ROM media (.lnx .lyx .o .zip); reset emulator and auto-load .sym/.elf/.lbl/.noi symbols. Debugger state may be lost unless saved debugger settings are enabled.

tools.name: load_bios
tools.title: Load BIOS
tools.description: Load Atari Lynx BIOS file; must be exactly 512 bytes.

tools.name: load_symbols
tools.title: Load Symbols
tools.description: Load debug symbols (.sym ADDRESS LABEL, llvm-nm text, llvm-mos ELF, and other supported labels); append to symbol table.

tools.name: list_save_state_slots
tools.title: List Save Slots
tools.description: List save-state slots: slot, ROM name, timestamp, screenshot flag.

tools.name: select_save_state_slot
tools.title: Select Save Slot
tools.description: Select active save-state slot 1-5 for save_state/load_state.

tools.name: save_state
tools.title: Save State
tools.description: Save emulator state to active save-state slot.

tools.name: load_state
tools.title: Load State
tools.description: Load emulator state from active save-state slot.

tools.name: save_state_file
tools.title: Save State File
tools.description: Save emulator state to an explicit file path.

tools.name: load_state_file
tools.title: Load State File
tools.description: Load emulator state from an explicit file path.

tools.name: set_fast_forward_speed
tools.title: Set Fast Forward Speed
tools.description: Set fast-forward speed index: 0=1.5x, 1=2x, 2=2.5x, 3=3x, 4=unlimited.

tools.name: toggle_fast_forward
tools.title: Toggle Fast Forward
tools.description: Enable/disable fast-forward mode at configured speed.

tools.name: controller_button
tools.title: Controller Button
tools.description: Press/release/tap Atari Lynx input: up/down/left/right/a/b/option1/option2/pause.

tools.name: controller_macro
tools.title: Controller Macro
tools.description: Run a frame-based controller macro. Commands are tap, press, release, and wait.

tools.name: get_input_state
tools.title: Get Input State
tools.description: Get effective pressed buttons and pending tap releases.

tools.name: debug_run_to_cursor
tools.title: Run to Address
tools.description: Continue execution until CPU address.

tools.name: add_disassembler_bookmark
tools.title: Add Disassembler Bookmark
tools.description: Add disassembler bookmark at CPU address.

tools.name: remove_disassembler_bookmark
tools.title: Remove Disassembler Bookmark
tools.description: Remove disassembler bookmark at CPU address.

tools.name: add_symbol
tools.title: Add Symbol
tools.description: Add disassembler symbol/label at CPU address.

tools.name: remove_symbol
tools.title: Remove Symbol
tools.description: Remove disassembler symbol/label at CPU address.

tools.name: select_memory_range
tools.title: Select Memory Range
tools.description: Select memory editor range by area and CPU addresses.

tools.name: set_memory_selection_value
tools.title: Fill Memory Selection
tools.description: Fill current memory selection with byte value; use select_memory_range first.

tools.name: add_memory_bookmark
tools.title: Add Memory Bookmark
tools.description: Add memory bookmark at area CPU address.

tools.name: remove_memory_bookmark
tools.title: Remove Memory Bookmark
tools.description: Remove memory bookmark at area CPU address.

tools.name: add_memory_watch
tools.title: Add Memory Watch
tools.description: Add memory watch at area CPU address with optional notes and bit size.

tools.name: remove_memory_watch
tools.title: Remove Memory Watch
tools.description: Remove memory watch at area CPU address.

tools.name: list_disassembler_bookmarks
tools.title: List Disassembler Bookmarks
tools.description: List disassembler bookmarks.

tools.name: list_symbols
tools.title: List Symbols
tools.description: List disassembler symbols/labels.

tools.name: lookup_symbol_by_name
tools.title: Lookup Symbol by Name
tools.description: Find exact symbol name; return all matches.

tools.name: lookup_symbol_at_address
tools.title: Lookup Symbol at Address
tools.description: Find symbol at address.

tools.name: get_call_stack
tools.title: Get Call Stack
tools.description: List current call stack/subroutine hierarchy.

tools.name: list_memory_bookmarks
tools.title: List Memory Bookmarks
tools.description: List bookmarks for memory area.

tools.name: list_memory_watches
tools.title: List Memory Watches
tools.description: List watches for memory area.

tools.name: get_memory_selection
tools.title: Get Memory Selection
tools.description: Read current memory selection range for area.

tools.name: memory_search_capture
tools.title: Capture Memory Snapshot
tools.description: Snapshot memory area for later value-change search.

tools.name: memory_search
tools.title: Search Memory
tools.description: Search memory values by comparison against snapshot, constant value, or address.

tools.name: memory_find
tools.title: Find Bytes or Text in Memory
tools.description: Find consecutive hex bytes or text in memory; return addresses.

tools.name: get_trace_log
tools.title: Get Trace Log
tools.description: Read trace log entries: CPU instructions and hardware/debug events.

tools.name: set_trace_log
tools.title: Set Trace Logger
tools.description: Enable/disable trace logging to memory or disk; configure capacity, file limit, output directory, event filters, and debug output.

tools.name: get_rewind_status
tools.title: Get Rewind Status
tools.description: Read rewind buffer: snapshot count, capacity, buffered seconds, configuration.

tools.name: rewind_seek
tools.title: Rewind Seek
tools.description: Load rewind snapshot by number; 1 oldest, snapshot_count newest; pause first; non-consuming reusable seek.

tools.name: list_tool_categories
tools.title: List Tool Categories
tools.description: List routed MCP tool categories with descriptions and tool counts. Use this first to discover advanced emulator/debugger tools.

tools.name: get_category_tools
tools.title: Get Category Tools
tools.description: List routed tools in a category with compact descriptions. Use category names returned by list_tool_categories, then call get_tool_info for one tool's input schema.

tools.name: get_tool_info
tools.title: Get Tool Info
tools.description: Return one MCP tool's title, description, category, direct/routed status, and real input schema. Use this after search_tools or get_category_tools before execute_tool.

tools.name: search_tools
tools.title: Search Tools
tools.description: Search direct and routed MCP tools by keyword, category, title, description, and aliases. Use this when you know what you want to do but not the tool name.

tools.name: execute_tool
tools.title: Execute Routed Tool
tools.description: Execute a routed MCP tool by name. First use search_tools or get_category_tools to discover the tool, then call get_tool_info to obtain its exact input schema.
